name: Microsoft Common Objects in COntext (MS COCO)
description: The MS COCO dataset is split into two parts, with the first half released in 2014 containing 82,783 training, 40,504 validation, and 40,775 testing images. The 2015 release will include a total of 165,482 training, 81,208 validation, and 81,434 testing images, with a focus on minimizing near-duplicate images across splits.

rai:responsibleAIMetadata.rai:dataCollection: Images were collected from Flickr and through pairwise searches of object categories to ensure a diverse set of non-iconic images. A filtering stage was applied to remove iconic images.
rai:responsibleAIMetadata.rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: 2014 for the first half; 2015 for the second half
rai:responsibleAIMetadata.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: Modified user interface developed by Bell et al.
rai:responsibleAIMetadata.rai:annotatorDemographics: Workers were trained and required to pass a training task to ensure quality, with approximately 1 in 3 workers passing.
rai:responsibleAIMetadata.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is intended for practical applications requiring precise localization of object instances and is beneficial for machine learning tasks.
